nombre_oficial.texto: The Casa Colorada and El Caracol

frase_gancho.texto: A building with a date and a round tower for watching the sky.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Here the landscape changes, with two stops. First the Red House, one of the best-preserved buildings at the site, with a carved date that corresponds to the year eight hundred sixty-nine, and the House of the Deer, badly deteriorated, beside it. Then El Caracol, the only round structure at Chichén Itzá. It is proposed that it was an observatory, and one study found lines of sight in it for twenty of twenty-nine sky events. Part of the tower has been lost, so not everything can be verified.
